name: sgs/tabs
title: SGS Tabs
description: Tabbed content with horizontal or vertical layout, full ARIA support, and deep linking via URL hash.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: block.json declares no `typography` support at all on this block — every text-cluster member beyond colour is an honest gap. The 12 ARRANGEMENT members also apply here (layer OUTER) and are resolved by the sibling `inner` element.

inner.label: Inner (grid / flex layout)
inner._note: Composite-mirror grid capability (shared SGS_Container_Wrapper, kind='layout'). Maps explicitly — no `prefix` declared, so the default convention cannot resolve bare camelCase attrs (ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1). This block has NO `alignItems` attribute at all — an honest gap, not an omission.

tab.label: Tab (resting state)
tab._note: Resting-state colour + shared transition duration only. tabActiveTextColour/tabActiveBgColour/tabActiveIndicatorColour/tabHoverBgColour are the SELECTED/HOVER state variants — Spec 35 FR-35-5 — declared explicitly via `states.<name>.attrMap` because the naming is irregular (infix `Active`/`Hover`, not a suffix) and `tabActiveTextColour` renders as `[aria-selected="true"]` (render.php:232, style.css:110), NOT CSS `:active`; `tabActiveIndicatorColour` is mapped to css:border-color (render.php:88 — it drives the underline/box-shadow indicator colour). `tabBgColour`/`tabIndicatorColour` (added Task 4b) are the RESTING bases those two states now sit between — token-fallback `transparent`, so an unconfigured client renders byte-identical to before (style.css:68, :121-128). No transition-timing-function attribute exists on this block — an honest gap.

panel.label: Tab panel
panel._note: Only background + border-colour are independently controlled for the panel — the remaining fill/layout members are honest gaps. Hover state added FR-colour-conformance-closeout.

tabTextColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting tab label text instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over tabTextColour at render time.

tabBgColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting tab background via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over tabBgColour.

tabIndicatorColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the resting tab indicator instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over tabIndicatorColour at render time (D636 border-colour rollout).

tabActiveIndicatorColourGradient.description: Selected-state sibling of tabIndicatorColourGradient. Non-empty wins over tabActiveIndicatorColour when the tab is selected.

panelBgColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the panel background via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over panelBgColour.

panelBgColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the panel background on hover via background-image. Non-empty wins over panelBgColourHover.

panelBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the panel border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over panelBorderColour at render time (D636 border-colour rollout).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
